sources.title: FTI tutorial
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Open MPI ULFM：縮減 communicator 與資料重分配
related.titleEn: Open MPI ULFM: communicator shrink and data redistribution
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：儲存成本已算，其他成本不足時明示資料不足。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Storage cost is computed and insufficient evidence for other costs remains explicit.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Open MPI ULFM：縮減 communicator 與資料重分配」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付舊／新rank映射、2400 MiB分配表與資料恢復驗收。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Open MPI ULFM: communicator shrink and data redistribution with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver old/new rank maps, 2400 MiB allocation tables and data-recovery acceptance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 把64 GiB原始資料複製一次，兩副本放不同故障域。
移除一rank，重新編號survivors，再從完整checkpoint分配2400 MiB。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Duplicate 64 GiB once and place copies in separate failure domains.
Remove one rank, renumber survivors and distribute 2400 MiB from the complete checkpoint.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OCP 液冷迴路：冷板熱量與質量流率
related.titleEn: OCP liquid cooling loops: cold-plate heat and mass flow
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：儲存成本已算，其他成本不足時明示資料不足。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Storage cost is computed and insufficient evidence for other costs remains explicit.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「OCP 液冷迴路：冷板熱量與質量流率」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付TCS/FWS邊界、熱量流圖、兩組流率與待驗證機械條件。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct OCP liquid cooling loops: cold-plate heat and mass flow with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver TCS/FWS boundaries, heat-flow maps, two flow rates and unresolved mechanical conditions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 把64 GiB原始資料複製一次，兩副本放不同故障域。
先確認kW=kJ/s，再以60除4.18×10，寫出質量流率單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Duplicate 64 GiB once and place copies in separate failure domains.
Confirm kW=kJ/s, divide 60 by 4.18×10 and derive mass-flow units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
